items.content_text: - **CFTC directs prediction market exchanges to end domestic geographic restrictions within 30 days, NJToday reports** — The CFTC has issued an interpretation directing designated contract markets and prediction market platforms to cease domestic geographic restrictions within 30 days or explain why compliance is not feasible, citing impartial access requirements under Regulation 38.151(b).
